title: Tim Cook Sold Out Steve Jobs
summary: Anil Dash's opinion piece critically examining Apple's strategic and philosophical shifts under Tim Cook's leadership compared to Steve Jobs' era, questioning whether Apple has deviated from its founding vision.
problem_solved: Expresses critical opinion about Apple's corporate direction and leadership decisions under Tim Cook.
why_valuable: Provides a thought-provoking perspective from a respected tech commentator on the evolution of a major technology company.
